LanguageData.SWS_Restart: Changes count after you restart the game.
LanguageData.SWS_Intro: Each switch makes a smaller work type with its own column in the Work tab. It starts with the priority of the work it came from, so nobody stops doing it. Switched off = as in the base game. Safe to change in a running save.
LanguageData.SWS_Steward: Steward plans the new work types on its own.
LanguageData.SWS_NoSteward: Without Steward you set the new columns yourself in the Work tab.
LanguageData.SWS_NoJobs: Nothing to move in this game (the DLC or mod with these jobs is not active, or another mod moved them).
LanguageData.SWS_AdvIntro: Any job – also from other mods – can go into another work type, including the smaller ones above. "Default" = where the job is without this setting. Left: the work type it came from.
LanguageData.SWS_Fold: Fold {0} into one column ({1} parts) – one cell then sets all of them
LanguageData.SWS_LookOther: Another Work tab mod is active (Work Tab, Compact Work Tab …) – it draws the tab, so these options are off.
LanguageData.SWS_Groups: Groups (fold parts into their main work)
LanguageData.SWS_GroupsTip: A coloured band over each split work with its parts. Click ▸ / ▾ on the band to fold the parts into the main column: one cell then sets all of them, "2–4" shows when they differ. Only the view changes – each part keeps its own priority.
LanguageData.SWS_NarrowTip: Columns only as wide as the priority box – more fits on the screen.
LanguageData.SWS_GroupOpenTip: Ticked = the parts have their own columns.
LanguageData.SWS_LookHint: Tip: in the Work tab click the coloured band above a main work to fold or unfold it.
